UN Report Warns of Accelerating Global Warming and Urgent Emission Cuts

A United Nations report indicates global temperatures are set to rise by 1.7-1.8 degrees Celsius, with a leading climate scientist stating global warming is accelerating. To avoid disastrously overshooting climate targets, the world must cut carbon emissions by nearly 18% in the next four years and close to half within a decade. The report highlights that every additional fraction of a degree and year of warming above 1.5°C increases risks like deadly floods, heatwaves, and wildfires. However, one report suggests the world is headed for a 2.8°C warming, and US emissions have risen.
